description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, inheriting from SampleActivityBase. It manages UI components such as a fragment for card reading, options menu for toggling logs, and initializes on-screen logging using support libraries. It contains methods for activity lifecycle, menu handling, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the main user interface, including a card reader fragment, options menu, and log display. It extends SampleActivityBase and implements initialization of logging infrastructure.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout and adding the CardReaderFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, setting the visibility and title of the log toggle item based on current UI state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling log visibility and updating UI.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with wrappers and filters, attaching it to on-screen log display.
